content.text: Please build a polished, mobile-friendly one-page site for fictional Taco Cometa: clear hero and sample menu with prices, vegetarian options, sample visit/location details, and a friendly story. Mark menu, prices, and visit details as samples; no ordering, payment, analytics, customer form, remote assets, or unverified operational claims.
I’ll build the first draft as a self-contained page, keep all menu and visit details explicitly labeled as samples, then open it at the required shared browser URL and check the phone layout.

For the visual direction, make the Cometa feel warm and neighborhood-run: a bold, legible headline, restrained tomato/cream palette, and a clear vegetarian marker on menu items. Keep sample labels easy to notice without dominating the page.

Engineering note: keep the page self-contained and semantic (real section headings/anchor links), with visible keyboard focus and responsive menu cards; sample labels should stay explicit in the rendered content.
QA acceptance: please make the sample menu and sample visit details easy to distinguish at a glance, and ensure the page remains readable and keyboard navigable on phone.

I have the client brief plus design, engineering, and QA notes. I’m carrying those through as warm tomato and cream styling, strong headings, semantic section links, clear sample labels, and a visible vegetarian marker.
